tools.name: get-latest-news
tools.description: Fetch the latest published news articles from Monitor Indonesia. Returns JSON with title, URL, publish date, and description.

tools.name: get-trending-news
tools.description: Fetch currently trending news articles from Monitor Indonesia. Returns JSON results.

tools.name: navigate-section
tools.description: Navigate the browser to a Monitor Indonesia section page. Valid sections: today (latest news), indeks (news index), video, photo, infographic, caricature, opini (opinions).

section.description: Section name: today, indeks, video, photo, infographic, caricature, or opini

tools.name: search-news
tools.description: Search Monitor Indonesia news articles by keyword. Returns JSON results with title, URL, publish date, and description.

query.description: Search query (keywords to find in article titles and content)
